name: fix-01
prompt:
Create ONE production game-icon SPRITE ATLAS, exactly 3 columns by 3 rows on a square canvas, ideally 2048x2048, genuinely TRANSPARENT alpha PNG. Input image is the user's approved style sheet, STYLE reference only. Match that soft tactile dimensional 3D collectible family: gentle warm upper-left diffuse studio light, rounded yet faithful forms, bright pastel/candy color, subtle ambient occlusion, restrained material detail. Each object's true material remains recognizable: paper, wood, glass, metal, woven cloth. No same-clay treatment on everything. No heavy dark outlines or flat vector art.

CRITICAL PACKAGING: There are EXACTLY NINE equal square virtual cells in a regular 3x3 grid. Draw ONE specified object/group centered within EACH virtual cell, at ONLY 48–52% of cell width/height, with at least 24% EMPTY TRANSPARENT MARGIN ON EVERY SIDE. Nothing may touch a virtual cell edge or cross into a neighbor. All strings, handles, leaves and shadows stay inside their own cell. Think SMALL MINIATURE ICONS with LARGE EMPTY GUTTERS, NOT large illustrations filling the sheet. Icon centers are x=16.67%,50%,83.33%, y=16.67%,50%,83.33% of the image. Each icon must fit in a box 18% of the overall image size. Empty space between shapes is essential. No visible grid lines, no backgrounds, no color squares, no borders, no captions, numbers, words, ID labels, titles or decorative props. Empty padding is genuine alpha transparency, NOT a drawn checkerboard. Top-left through bottom-right order is mandatory; do not swap cells. Each tile will be cropped at exact one-third boundaries into a separate icon. Keep centered and similarly weighted, readable at 32–66px. All objects fully in frame, no cropping. Only allow inscription glyphs explicitly specified in subject. Do not invent sacred symbols, cultural ornament, claims or text. No extra humans/hands/landscape/pedestals. Subject list in strict row-major order:
1. Cell row 1, column 1: A warm tan wooden doorway with a muted teal opening; a closed blue-green rounded rectangular case with brass-colored end bands is mounted diagonally on the right post. Retain only the existing small shin mark on the case; no open scroll or invented scripture. IMPORTANT CORRECTION overriding any ambiguous earlier description: The case has ONE small plain gold Hebrew letter ש (Shin U+05E9): three upright prongs joined along a curved bottom, no dot. The mark MUST be ש, ABSOLUTELY NO STAR shape or any other symbol. It is mounted on the right wooden doorpost.
2. Cell row 1, column 2: An upright golden wheat sheaf with complete grain heads, branching stalks and splayed straw feet; a coral-red tied ribbon with a narrow blue band gathers the waist. Keep the natural straw structure, without added icons or lettering. IMPORTANT CORRECTION overriding any ambiguous earlier description: The COMPLETE natural wheat sheaf and every grain head tip must be visible. Keep at least 15% clear space above the tallest wheat head. Never cut wheat at the top edge.
3. Cell row 1, column 3: A thick golden-brown cake slice with a pale cream top and warm crumb-colored sides rests on a pale ceramic plate with a muted teal rim; one small golden coin is visible at the front of the slice. Preserve the cut slice and single coin, without icing words, dates or extra decorations. IMPORTANT CORRECTION overriding any ambiguous earlier description: The small token is a SOLID PLAIN ROUND GOLD DISC. It has NO HOLE of any shape, NO square, NO lettering and NO symbol. Do not resemble a Chinese cash coin. Keep the circular cake and simple cut portion as described.
4. Cell row 2, column 1: A silver-colored scalloped lock pendant hangs from a warm orange-brown cotton cord loop, with three small silver drop ornaments below. Preserve the broad cloud-like curved outline and minimal linear face marks; no keyhole, key or invented inscription. IMPORTANT CORRECTION overriding any ambiguous earlier description: A COMPLETE continuous RED CORD LOOP arches above and connects BOTH upper shoulders of the silver lock. The WHOLE rounded loop is visible with generous transparent space above. No blunt cut-off red ends in place of the loop.
5. Cell row 2, column 2: A small upright honey-colored carved wooden bird has a black cap, ivory eyes, muted coral-red chest and simple dark wing and foot strokes above a flat base. Keep the tall compact wooden silhouette and painted color blocks, without real feathers or added writing. IMPORTANT CORRECTION overriding any ambiguous earlier description: CRITICAL exact silhouette: a TALL STRAIGHT FACETED HONEY-WOOD PILLAR BIRD with flat base and slightly chamfered top; black painted cap, two small ivory eyes, coral-red cheek/chest patch beneath cap and thin painted dark foot marks on the lower front. NO protruding wings, NO long tail, NO separate legs or bird claws, NO naturalistic songbird body. It is an upright block-shaped painted wooden figure.
6. Cell row 2, column 3: A muted teal doorway with a pale stone-colored frame has a dark teal lintel strip bearing the existing small ivory chalk blessing marks, with a short piece of ivory chalk below and a small gold door knob. Preserve the source glyph layout and simple doorway; no extra words or decorations. IMPORTANT CORRECTION overriding any ambiguous earlier description: On the dark teal horizontal lintel draw EXACTLY '+ C M B' as four spaced small IVORY CHALK glyphs on one straight line: a simple plus cross, uppercase C, uppercase M, uppercase B. NO flowers, dots, dates, years, stars or extra crosses.
7. Cell row 3, column 1: A warm golden-yellow woven ribbon wraps a muted teal metal railing, with three visible tied loops along the hanging portion and two long ribbon tails. Preserve the vertical bars, two crossbars and continuous ribbon path, without adding printed wording or extra charms. IMPORTANT CORRECTION overriding any ambiguous earlier description: ONE continuous narrow YELLOW WOVEN RIBBON wraps ONE spot of a short wooden railing. Its hanging section has THREE COMPACT OVERHAND KNOTS STACKED VERTICALLY along the SAME SINGLE STRIP, with ONLY TWO FREE ENDS. Not three separate ribbons, not three side-by-side loops or three colorful bands.
8. Cell row 3, column 2: A slender brown dogwood branch forms two stacked open rounded loops, decorated with a few ivory popcorn-like pieces and short coral-red wool tassels. Preserve the open looped twig structure and sparse tied decorations, without extra ribbons, bells or lettering. IMPORTANT CORRECTION overriding any ambiguous earlier description: The WHITE decorations on the red-wood/cornel twig loops are IRREGULAR PUFFED POPCORN pieces, with lumpy organic popped-kernel shapes. They are NOT five-petal flowers, NOT white blossoms, NOT beads. Retain the existing red ribbon and dried-fruit accents.
9. Bottom-right cell: leave COMPLETELY EMPTY and transparent.
